sentences.text: In short: MENGER INVEST AS is an established company in "kjøp og salg av egen fast eiendom" based in Oslo, profitable in 2025.

MENGER INVEST AS is registered in the industry "Kjøp og salg av egen fast eiendom"; its registered activity is "Kjøp og salg av verdipapirer, eiendom og annet som måtte falle naturlig sammen med dette.".
MENGER INVEST AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2006-02-28, registered in Oslo.
It reported revenue of NOK 172,502 for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 146,340 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 84.8% and a strong equity ratio of 100% of total assets.

Revenue rose 1.2% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 170,384 to NOK 172,502); it was NOK 190,749 in 2023. The annual result went from a loss in 2024 to a profit in 2025 (2023: NOK 26,787, 2024: -NOK 248,509, 2025: NOK 412,604).
MENGER INVEST AS is led by board chair Morten Enger Grønvold.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2022-08-04.
MENGER INVEST AS has 1 registered workplace.
